attitudes.title: Left–right self-placement
attitudes.question: Do Poles place themselves on the left or on the right?
attitudes.measure: Average self-placement, from 0 (left) to 10 (right)

attitudes.title: Economic left–right
attitudes.question: Do Poles want more state or more market in the economy?
attitudes.measure: Average position on economic questions, from 0 (left) to 10 (right)

attitudes.title: Libertarian–traditional values (GAL–TAN)
attitudes.question: Are Poles becoming more libertarian or more traditional?
attitudes.measure: Average position on social and cultural questions, from 0 (libertarian) to 10 (traditional)

attitudes.title: Redistribution
attitudes.question: Should the state reduce the gap between rich and poor?
attitudes.measure: Average position on redistribution, from 0 (for redistribution from rich to poor) to 10 (against)

attitudes.title: State and market
attitudes.question: Should the economy be run by the state or by the market?
attitudes.measure: Average position on the role of the state in the economy, from 0 (state) to 10 (market)

attitudes.title: Welfare and public spending
attitudes.question: Should the state provide more, or should taxes be lower?
attitudes.measure: Average position on public services and benefits, from 0 (more public services and benefits) to 10 (lower taxes and self-reliance)

attitudes.title: Trade and foreign capital
attitudes.question: Should Poland protect its economy from foreign competition and capital?
attitudes.measure: Average position on trade and foreign capital, from 0 (free trade) to 10 (protection)

attitudes.title: Agriculture
attitudes.question: Should the state support farmers?
attitudes.measure: Average position on support for agriculture, from 0 (urban interests: no special support) to 10 (rural interests: subsidies and protection)

attitudes.title: Social lifestyle
attitudes.question: How liberal are Poles on abortion, gay rights and other moral questions?
attitudes.measure: Average position on social lifestyle questions, from 0 (liberal) to 10 (conservative)

attitudes.title: Gay and lesbian rights
attitudes.question: Do Poles support equal rights for gay and lesbian couples?
attitudes.measure: Average position on gay and lesbian rights, from 0 (for equal rights) to 10 (against)

attitudes.title: Women's rights
attitudes.question: Should women and men have the same roles at home, at work and in politics?
attitudes.measure: Average position on women's roles and rights, from 0 (equality) to 10 (traditional roles)

attitudes.title: Church and state
attitudes.question: Should the Church have a say in public life?
attitudes.measure: Average position on the Church and the state, from 0 (a secular state) to 10 (religious principles in politics)

attitudes.title: Law and order
attitudes.question: Should the state be tough on crime, or protect civil liberties?
attitudes.measure: Average position on crime and punishment, from 0 (civil liberties) to 10 (tough on crime)

attitudes.title: Environment and climate
attitudes.question: Should the environment come before economic growth?
attitudes.measure: Average position on the environment and the climate, from 0 (environment first) to 10 (growth first)

attitudes.title: Immigration
attitudes.question: Should Poland welcome immigrants and refugees?
attitudes.measure: Average position on immigration and refugees, from 0 (open) to 10 (restrictive)

attitudes.title: Integration of immigrants
attitudes.question: Should immigrants keep their own ways, or adapt to Polish ones?
attitudes.measure: Average position on the integration of immigrants, from 0 (multiculturalism) to 10 (assimilation)

attitudes.title: Nationalism
attitudes.question: What makes a true Pole?
attitudes.measure: Average position on the nation, from 0 (cosmopolitan) to 10 (nationalist)

attitudes.title: Minority rights
attitudes.question: Should national and ethnic minorities have more rights?
attitudes.measure: Average position on minority rights, from 0 (more rights) to 10 (the majority first)

attitudes.title: Support for EU membership
attitudes.question: Do Poles support their country's membership of the European Union?
attitudes.measure: Supporters of EU membership, % of those with a view

attitudes.title: European integration
attitudes.question: Should Poland seek closer European integration or guard its independence?
attitudes.measure: Average position on European integration, from 0 (guard national independence) to 10 (closer integration)

attitudes.title: Support for NATO
attitudes.question: Do Poles support NATO and Poland's membership of it?
attitudes.measure: Average support for NATO and Poland's membership, from 0 (opposed) to 10 (strongly in favour)

attitudes.title: Satisfaction with democracy
attitudes.question: How satisfied are Poles with the way democracy works in Poland?
attitudes.measure: Average satisfaction with the way democracy works in Poland, from 0 (not at all satisfied) to 10 (very satisfied)

attitudes.title: Support for democracy
attitudes.question: Do Poles prefer democracy to any other form of government?
attitudes.measure: Average support for democracy as the best form of government, from 0 (another system can be better) to 10 (democracy is best)

attitudes.title: Government support
attitudes.question: Do Poles support the government of the day?
attitudes.measure: Average support for the government of the day, from 0 (opponent) to 10 (supporter)

attitudes.title: Strong leader
attitudes.question: Would a strong leader unconstrained by parliament be good for Poland?
attitudes.measure: Average position on executive power, from 0 (a constrained executive) to 10 (a strong leader unconstrained by parliament)

attitudes.title: Courts and the government
attitudes.question: Should the courts be able to stop the government?
attitudes.measure: Average position on judicial independence, from 0 (independent courts) to 10 (government influence over the courts)

attitudes.title: Populist attitudes
attitudes.question: Should the people or their representatives decide?
attitudes.measure: Average position on populist attitudes, from 0 (trust in elected representatives) to 10 (the people against the elite)

attitudes.title: Political efficacy
attitudes.question: Do Poles feel they have a say in politics?
attitudes.measure: Average sense of political efficacy, from 0 (people like me have no say) to 10 (people like me have a say)

attitudes.title: Interest in politics
attitudes.question: How interested are Poles in politics?
attitudes.measure: Average interest in politics, from 0 (none) to 10 (very great)

attitudes.title: Trust in parliament
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the Sejm and parliament?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in parliament, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in politicians
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust politicians?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in politicians, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in political parties
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust political parties?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in political parties, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the courts
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the courts and the justice system?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the courts and the justice system, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the police
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the police?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the police, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the army
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the armed forces?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the armed forces, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in local government
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust local government?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in local government, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the EU
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the European Union?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the European Union, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the Church
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the Church?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the Church, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in the media
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust the press, television and the media?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in the press, television and the media, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Trust in trade unions
attitudes.question: How much do Poles trust trade unions?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in trade unions, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)

attitudes.title: Social trust
attitudes.question: Can most people be trusted?
attitudes.measure: Average trust in other people, from 0 (you can't be too careful) to 10 (most people can be trusted)

attitudes.title: Direction of the country
attitudes.question: Are things in Poland going in the right direction?
attitudes.measure: Average view of the country's direction, from 0 (wrong direction) to 10 (right direction)

attitudes.title: The economy
attitudes.question: How do Poles rate the state of the Polish economy?
attitudes.measure: Average rating of the Polish economy, from 0 (very bad) to 10 (very good)

attitudes.title: Economic expectations
attitudes.question: Do Poles expect the economy to improve?
attitudes.measure: Average expectation for the Polish economy in the coming year, from 0 (much worse) to 10 (much better)

attitudes.title: Religious practice
attitudes.question: How often do Poles go to church?
attitudes.measure: Average frequency of attending religious services, from 0 (never) to 10 (more than once a week)

attitudes.title: Religiosity
attitudes.question: How religious are Poles?
attitudes.measure: Average religiosity, from 0 (not at all religious) to 10 (deeply religious)

attitudes.title: Conspiracy beliefs
attitudes.question: Do Poles think hidden forces shape events?
attitudes.measure: Average belief that hidden forces or conspiracies shape events, from 0 (disbelief) to 10 (strong belief)

attitudes.title: Views of communist Poland
attitudes.question: Do Poles look back on communist Poland (the PRL) favourably?
attitudes.measure: Average view of communist Poland, from 0 (very negative) to 10 (very positive)

attitudes.title: Views of the transformation
attitudes.question: Was the change of system after 1989 worth it?
attitudes.measure: Average view of the change of system after 1989, from 0 (not worth it, more losses) to 10 (worth it, more gains)

attitudes.title: Decommunisation
attitudes.question: Should former communists be held to account?
attitudes.measure: Average support for decommunisation and lustration, from 0 (opposed) to 10 (strongly in favour)

attitudes.title: Household material situation
attitudes.question: How do Poles rate their household's material situation?
attitudes.measure: Average rating of one's household's material situation, from 0 (very bad) to 10 (very good)

attitudes.title: Household expectations
attitudes.question: Do Poles expect their household's situation to improve?
attitudes.measure: Average expectation for one's household's material situation in the coming year, from 0 (much worse) to 10 (much better)

attitudes.title: Life satisfaction
attitudes.question: How satisfied are Poles with their lives?
attitudes.measure: Average satisfaction with life as a whole, from 0 (not at all satisfied) to 10 (completely satisfied)

attitudes.title: Happiness
attitudes.question: How happy are Poles?
attitudes.measure: Average happiness, from 0 (not at all happy) to 10 (very happy)
